title: Compact Storage
flavorText: Vacuum-sealed lockers packed into unused half-slots.

title: Data Siphon
flavorText: Taps anomaly chatter and bottles it as cargo before the phase turns.
rulesText: At the end of the Action phase, before Maintenance, if this ship is in an Anomaly sector, gain 1 resource of your choice from the general supply into this ship's cargo. Once per global round.

title: Scavenger Drones
flavorText: Drones that skim the wreck field for usable salvage.
rulesText: Whenever your fleet destroys a ship, gain +1 resource of your choice from the general supply into this ship's cargo.

title: Cargo Containers
flavorText: Stackable pods that bolt on wherever the frame has room.

title: Crew Quarters
flavorText: Cramped bunks and life support for one more specialist.

title: Expanded Cargo Bay
flavorText: A refit bay that trades weapon space for honest freight tonnage.

title: Bulk Storage
flavorText: Double-height racks and oversized locks for serious haulers.

title: Luxury Quarters
flavorText: Private suites that make senior crew willing to sign on.
rulesText: When you recruit crew for this ship, remove any 2 resources of your choice from the recruit cost (minimum 0).

title: Security Credentials
flavorText: Forged clearance codes for the busiest hub in the sector.
rulesText: This ship may use Interact actions at the Central Nexus even if opposing ships are present.

title: Habitation Block
flavorText: A full hab ring with bunks, galley, and recycler loops for a larger crew.

title: Smuggler's Hold
flavorText: Hidden compartment where one resource rides outside the manifest.
rulesText: Keep one resource in this Hold on the card. That cargo can only be taken by other players or card effects if this component is destroyed.
